Package rgen

Class RandGen

java.lang.Object
rgen.RandGen
Direct Known Subclasses:
LCG
public abstract class RandGen extends Object
The RandGen Abstract class is a blueprint for building a Random Number Generator
Supports having a 32 or 64 bit state, and has a wide variety of functions to generate with
